verses.original: מַֽעֲנֶה־ רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־ עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־ אָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ă·neh- raḵ yā·šîḇ ḥê·māh ū·ḏə·ḇar- ‘e·ṣeḇ ya·‘ă·leh- ’āp̄
verses.literal: A gentle answer turns away wrath but a harsh word stirs up anger
verses.literalPt: Uma resposta branda desvia o furor, mas a palavra dura excita a ira.

verses.original: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šō·wn ḥă·ḵā·mîm tê·ṭîḇ dā·‘aṯ ū·p̄î ḵə·sî·lîm yab·bî·a‘ ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge but the mouth of the fool spouts folly
verses.literalPt: A língua dos sábios destila o conhecimento, mas a boca dos loucos derrama a estultícia.

verses.original: בְּֽכָל־ מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl mā·qō·wm ‘ê·nê Yah·weh ṣō·p̄ō·wṯ rā·‘îm w·ṭō·ḇīm
verses.literal: The eyes of the LORD are in every place observing the evil and the good
verses.literalPt: Os olhos de Jeová estão em todo lugar, vigiando aos maus e aos bons.

verses.original: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: mar·pê lā·šō·wn ‘êṣ ḥay·yîm wə·se·lep̄ bāh še·ḇer bə·rū·aḥ
verses.literal: A soothing tongue is a tree of life but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit
verses.literalPt: A língua suave é árvore de vida, mas a perversa quebranta o espírito.

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·wîl yin·’aṣ mū·sar ’ā·ḇîw wə·šō·mêr tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ ya‘·rim
verses.literal: A fool rejects his father’s discipline but whoever heeds correction is prudent
verses.literalPt: O insensato despreza a correção de seu pai, mas aquele que atende à repreensão consegue a prudência.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ ṣad·dîq ḥō·sen rāḇ ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·’aṯ rā·šā‘ ne‘·kā·reṯ
verses.literal: The house of the righteous has great treasure but the income of the wicked is trouble
verses.literalPt: Na casa do justo, há grandes tesouros, Mas, nas rendas do perverso, há perturbação.

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: śip̄·ṯê ḥă·ḵā·mîm yə·zā·rū ḏā·‘aṯ wə·lêḇ kə·sî·lîm lō- ḵên
verses.literal: The lips of the wise spread knowledge but not so the hearts of fools
verses.literalPt: Os lábios dos sábios difundem o conhecimento, porém não o faz o coração dos loucos.

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ rə·šā·‘îm tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ū·ṯə·p̄il·laṯ yə·šā·rîm rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD but the prayer of the upright is His delight
verses.literalPt: O sacrifício dos perversos é abominação a Jeová, mas a oração dos retos é-lhe agradável.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh de·reḵ rā·šā‘ ū·mə·rad·dêp̄ ṣə·ḏā·qāh ye·’ĕ·hāḇ
verses.literal: The LORD detests the way of the wicked but He loves those who pursue righteousness
verses.literalPt: O caminho dos perversos é abominação a Jeová, mas ele ama ao que segue a justiça.

verses.original: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: mū·sār rā‘ lə·‘ō·zêḇ ’ō·raḥ śō·w·nê ṯō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path he who hates correction will die
verses.literalPt: Correção rigorosa há para quem abandona o caminho, e aquele que aborrece a repreensão morrerá.

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl wa·’ă·ḇad·dō·wn ne·ḡeḏ Yah·weh ’ap̄ kî- lib·bō·wṯ bə·nê- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD how much more . . . the hearts of men
verses.literalPt: O Sheol e Abadom estão diante de Jeová, quanto mais os corações dos filhos dos homens!

verses.original: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־ לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל־ חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ye·’ĕ·haḇ- lêṣ hō·w·ḵê·aḥ lōw ’el- ḥă·ḵā·mîm lō yê·lêḵ
verses.literal: A mocker does not love to be reproved nor will he consult . . . the wise
verses.literalPt: O escarnecedor não gosta de quem o repreende; não irá ter com os sábios.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־ לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ śā·mē·aḥ yê·ṭiḇ pā·nîm ū·ḇə·‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇaṯ- lêḇ rū·aḥ nə·ḵê·’āh
verses.literal: A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit
verses.literalPt: O coração alegre torna contente o rosto, mas com a tristeza do coração abate-se o espírito.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־ דָּ֑עַת וּפְנֵי כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ nā·ḇō·wn yə·ḇaq·qeš- dā·‘aṯ ū·p̄ə·nē ḵə·sî·lîm yir·‘eh ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: A discerning heart seeks knowledge but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly
verses.literalPt: O coração do inteligente busca o conhecimento, mas a boca dos loucos se apascenta de estultícia.

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־ לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê ‘ā·nî rā·‘îm wə·ṭō·wḇ- lêḇ miš·teh ṯā·mîḏ
verses.literal: All the days of the oppressed are bad but a cheerful heart has a continual feast
verses.literalPt: Todos os dias do aflito são maus, mas o homem feliz tem um banquete contínuo.

verses.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- mə·‘aṭ bə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh mê·’ō·w·ṣār rāḇ ū·mə·hū·māh ḇōw
verses.literal: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil
verses.literalPt: Melhor é o pouco com o temor de Jeová do que grandes tesouros, e, com eles, a inquietação.

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־ שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ’ă·ru·ḥaṯ yā·rāq wə·’a·hă·ḇāh- šām miš·šō·wr ’ā·ḇūs wə·śin·’āh- ḇōw
verses.literal: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred
verses.literalPt: Melhor é o prato de hortaliças onde há amor do que o boi cevado, e, com ele, o ódio.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ḥê·māh yə·ḡā·reh mā·ḏō·wn wə·ʾɛ·rɛḵ ’ap·pa·yim yaš·qîṭ rîḇ
verses.literal: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife but he who is slow to anger calms dispute
verses.literalPt: O homem irascível excita rixas; mas quem é tardio em irar-se aplaca contendas.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ ‘ā·ṣêl kim·śu·ḵaṯ ḥā·ḏeq wə·’ō·raḥ yə·šā·rîm sə·lu·lāh
verses.literal: The way of the slacker is like a hedge of thorns but the path of the upright is a highway
verses.literalPt: O caminho do preguiçoso é como uma sebe de espinhos, mas a vereda dos justos é uma estrada real.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־ אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bên ḥā·ḵām yə·śam·maḥ- ’āḇ ū·ḵə·sîl ’ā·ḏām bō·w·zeh ’im·mōw
verses.literal: A wise son brings joy to his father but a foolish man despises his mother
verses.literalPt: O filho sábio alegra a seu pai, mas o homem insensato despreza a sua mãe.

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר־ לָֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’iw·we·leṯ śim·ḥāh la·ḥă·sar- lêḇ wə·’îš tə·ḇū·nāh yə·yaš·šer- lå̄·ḵɛṯ
verses.literal: Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment but a man of understanding walks a straight path
verses.literalPt: A estultícia é alegria para quem é falto de sabedoria, mas o homem de entendimento faz direito o seu caminho.

verses.original: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄êr ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ bə·’ên sō·wḏ ū·ḇə·rōḇ yō·w·‘ă·ṣîm tā·qūm
verses.literal: Plans fail for lack of counsel but with many advisers they succeed
verses.literalPt: Onde não há conselho, dissipam-se os planos; mas os muitos conselhos os estabelecem.

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־ פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה־ טּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥāh lā·’îš bə·ma·‘ă·nêh- p̄îw wə·ḏā·ḇār bə·‘it·tōw mah- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: A man takes joy in a fitting reply . . . and how good is a timely word
verses.literalPt: O homem alegra-se em dar uma resposta; e a palavra a seu tempo, quão boa é!

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·raḥ ḥay·yîm lə·ma‘·lāh lə·maś·kîl lə·ma·‘an sūr miš·šə·’ō·wl māṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: The path of life leads upward for the wise that he may avoid going down to Sheol
verses.literalPt: Para o sábio, o caminho da vida é para cima, a fim de evitar o Sheol, que é embaixo.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ gê·’îm yis·saḥ Yah·weh wə·yaṣ·ṣêḇ gə·ḇūl ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD tears down the house of the proud but He protects the boundaries of the widow
verses.literalPt: Jeová desarraigará a casa dos soberbos, mas estabelecerá os termos da viúva.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי־ נֹֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ rā‘ ū·ṭə·hō·rîm ’im·rê- nō·‘am
verses.literal: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked but the words of the pure are pleasant to Him
verses.literalPt: Maus desígnios são abominação a Jeová, mas palavras agradáveis são puras.

verses.original: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḵêr bê·ṯōw bō·w·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ wə·śō·w·nê mat·tā·nōṯ yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household but he who hates bribes will live
verses.literalPt: Aquele que tem espírito de ganância perturba a sua casa, mas quem aborrece dádivas, viverá.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ṣad·dîq yeh·geh la·‘ă·nō·wṯ ū·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm yab·bî·a‘ rā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil
verses.literalPt: O coração do justo medita no que há de responder, mas a boca dos perversos derrama coisas más.

verses.original: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: rā·ḥō·wq Yah·weh mê·rə·šā·‘îm ū·ṯə·p̄il·laṯ ṣad·dî·qîm yiš·mā‘
verses.literal: The LORD is far from the wicked but He hears the prayer of the righteous
verses.literalPt: Jeová está longe dos perversos, mas ouve a oração dos justos.

verses.original: מְֽאוֹר־ עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־ לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־ עָֽצֶם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·’ō·wr- ‘ê·na·yim yə·śam·maḥ- lêḇ šə·mū·‘āh ṭō·w·ḇāh tə·ḏaš·šen- ‘ā·ṣem
verses.literal: The light of the eyes cheers the heart and good news nourishes the bones
verses.literalPt: A luz dos olhos alegra ao coração, e boas novas engordam aos ossos.

verses.original: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·zen šō·ma·ʿaṯ tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ ḥay·yîm bə·qe·reḇ ḥă·ḵā·mîm tā·lîn
verses.literal: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise
verses.literalPt: O ouvido que escuta a repreensão que dá a vida terá a sua morada entre os sábios.

verses.original: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: pō·w·rê·a‘ mū·så̄r mō·w·’ês nap̄·šōw wə·šō·w·mê·a‘ tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ qō·w·neh lêḇ
verses.literal: He who ignores discipline despises himself but whoever heeds correction gains understanding
verses.literalPt: Quem rejeita a correção despreza a sua alma, mas aquele que escuta a repreensão adquire conhecimento.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh mū·sar ḥāḵ·māh wə·lip̄·nê ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ‘ă·nā·wāh
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom and humility comes before honor
verses.literalPt: O temor de Jeová é a instrução da sabedoria, e adiante da honra vai a humildade.
